newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia receives 20 foreign bids for Retorno 1.
newsitem.headline: Colombia receives 20 foreign bids for Retorno 1.

text.p: State-run oil company Ecopetrol said Sunday that 20 foreign firms had bid for contract rights for the Retorno 1 oil and gas prospect in northern Colombia.
The field, near the town of Sabana de Torres in Santander province, is believed to have reserves of anywhere between 74 million and 300 million barrels of crude, according to Ecopetrol estimates.
The reserves are at an average depth of 17,500 feet (5,380 meters), Ecopetrol said in a statement issued Sunday.
Ecopetrol invited bids for a "shared risk" contract to exploit the field, which will see the state-oil company sharing 50 percent of exploration costs with the associate company.
No date was given for when the contract would be awarded.

Bids have been received from British Petroleum Co Ltd, Occidental Petroleum Corp, Texas Petroleum Co, Maxus Energy Corp, Exxon Corp, Japan National Oil Corp, Amoco, Canadian Petroleum Ltd, Santa Fe Energy Resources Ltd, Elf Aquitaine, Petrobras, Preussag Energie, Coastal, Demimex Colombia Petroleum Sucursal, Repsol, Triton Energy Corp, Hocol, Lasmo, Arco and Dupont unit Conoco.
